env.name: OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID
env.label: Entra ID app (client) ID (App registrations; "Allow public client flows" on)

env.name: OUTLOOK_SECRET_KEY
env.label: Encryption key for stored sign-in tokens (Fernet key); changing it means every mailbox reconnects

env.name: OUTLOOK_PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Public URL for the browser sign-in fallback; register <URL>/auth/callback as a redirect URI (optional)

env.name: OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET
env.label: Client secret, only for a confidential app registration (optional)

env.name: EVENTHUB_CONNECTION
env.label: Events: Event Hub listen-only connection string, with EntityPath=<hub>

env.name: WATCH_FALLBACK_S
env.label: Safety poll for new mail, in seconds

env.name: OUTLOOK_ORG_CLIENT_ID
env.label: Organization app: Application (client) ID, not the Entra ID app's

env.name: OUTLOOK_ORG_CLIENT_SECRET
env.label: Organization app: client secret Value (not its Secret ID)

env.name: OUTLOOK_ORG_GROUP
env.label: Organization: Object ID of the VIP group

env.name: OUTLOOK_MOCK_GRAPH
env.label: Use the built-in test mailbox (1 = on, optional)
